scope: Compare Autodesk's versioned DXF SubDMesh record names with local MESH reader/writer/class metadata and conflicting open-source older-version claims; refine implementation readiness without making a DWG or consumer support claim.

method.kind: Versioned Autodesk DXF reference review plus local source/test inspection
method.evidenceBoundary: Autodesk's versioned DXF references directly establish the documented record spelling and common AcDbSubDMesh fields for AC1024 and AC1027, not the earliest possible release. Open-source sources surface an older-version claim/sample lead, but the exact sample header, entity bytes, producer and provenance were not verified. Local self-readback does not establish version validity or independent conformance. This evidence does not establish an AcDbSubDMesh DWG layout, evaluated subdivision geometry, consumer geometry, or ACIS/B-rep semantics.

evidence.topic: Autodesk documents two version-specific DXF names for the same subdivision-surface class
observed: The AutoCAD 2010 DXF Reference maps AC1024 to AutoCAD 2010 and names the subdivision-surface entity record SUBDIVISION with subclass AcDbSubDMesh.
The AutoCAD 2010 reference lists the version, blend-crease, subdivision level, level-0 vertices, face-list, edges, crease values, and property-override framing for SUBDIVISION.
The AutoCAD 2013 DXF Reference maps AC1027 to AutoCAD 2013 and names the entity MESH with subclass AcDbSubDMesh and the same principal field family.
doesNotEstablish: the earliest AutoCAD release that accepts MESH/AcDbSubDMesh
that MESH is valid or invalid in AC1021 DXF
evidence.planUse: Define explicit documented AC1024 SUBDIVISION and AC1027/AC1032 MESH writer profiles and read both spellings into DRW_Mesh. Do not infer the earliest release or change older-target behavior until conflicting peer evidence is audited.

evidence.topic: Open-source sources conflict on older MESH availability but do not provide a verified older conformance witness
observed: The stable ezdxf MESH internals page (version shown as 1.4.4 when opened) says MESH was introduced in DXF R13/R14 and describes it as a compact PolyFaceMesh form.

LibreDWG's generated unknown-field census labels MESH field captures from test/test-data/2004/Surface.dxf; the directory contains a Surface.dxf link, but its contents could not be retrieved in this review.
Autodesk documents classic polygon/PFACE mesh as a POLYLINE variant separately from the AcDbSubDMesh MESH/SUBDIVISION entity family.

The Surface.dxf $ACADVER, raw source bytes, AcDbSubDMesh subclass/CLASS metadata, producer, source-file hash and generation provenance were not independently inspected; the folder label and generated field census are not a verified format-version witness.
The ezdxf page says edge/crease data matter when subdivision is applied, reinforcing that control-cage parsing does not demonstrate evaluated smooth-surface semantics.
doesNotEstablish: that the LibreDWG Surface.dxf file is AC1018 or any specific DXF version
that an R13/R14 MESH claim refers to AcDbSubDMesh rather than a terminology or entity-family distinction
that a target CAD application accepts pre-AC1024 MESH/AcDbSubDMesh output
evaluated subdivision surfaces, DWG MESH layout, ACIS/B-rep support, or consumer geometry
evidence.planUse: Preserve existing old-target writer behavior for compatibility but label it UNQUALIFIED. Add a bounded audit of the already-published sample before any older-version reject/allow policy change; if the sample cannot be verified, leave the minimum unresolved and make no support claim.

evidence.topic: Current local route and control do not implement or prove the documented version profile
observed: The writer emits MESH for every supported target newer than AC1009.
The DXF entity dispatch recognizes MESH but not SUBDIVISION.
The custom CLASS metadata table contains MESH/AcDbSubDMesh but no SUBDIVISION record mapping.
The generated ASCII/binary MESH round-trip sets AC1021 as its file version; self-readback verifies codec consistency only and cannot validate that target spelling/version.
doesNotEstablish: that current output is accepted by AutoCAD, ODA, LibreDWG, or another independent reader
that AC1024 and AC1027 class-table metadata are correct
evidence.planUse: Replace the current single-version-spelling positive with ASCII/binary AC1024 and AC1027 controls that assert $ACADVER, raw entity name, AcDbSubDMesh subclass, emitted CLASS metadata, typed readback, and following-record framing. Retain AC1021 only as an unqualified compatibility characterization; do not add a pre-AC1024 negative before the older-profile audit.

existingOwnersOnly: MESH DXF reader/writer and class-metadata routes
PAR-07 / S5 / S8 MESH version and consumer evidence rows
implementationReadiness.readyLocalSlice: Add target-version-aware record-name selection for the documented profiles (AC1024 SUBDIVISION; AC1027/AC1032 MESH), accept both input names, verify matching CLASS metadata, and add ASCII/binary controls for both profiles. Keep pre-AC1024 behavior unchanged but UNQUALIFIED, characterize it without treating it as conformance, and audit the existing LibreDWG Surface.dxf lead before deciding whether to reject or support older writes.

validation.additionalIfCliPolicyChanges: Run the affected dwg2dxf/DXF version-policy CTest only if shared version selection or CLI behavior changes.
